response.sql: WITH filtered_budgets AS (SELECT category, amount, spent, remaining FROM budget WHERE amount >= 75), category_stats AS (SELECT category, AVG(remaining) as avg_remaining, SUM(amount - spent) as total_amount_minus_spent FROM filtered_budgets GROUP BY category), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(total_amount_minus_spent) as avg_total FROM category_stats) SELECT c.category, c.avg_remaining, c.total_amount_minus_spent, c.total_amount_minus_spent - o.avg_total as above_average FROM category_stats c CROSS JOIN overall_average o WHERE c.total_amount_minus_spent > o.avg_total ORDER BY c.category

assumptions.assumption: "Passes the 75-dollar cutoff" means amount >= 75 (budgeted amount is at least 75 dollars), not strictly greater than 75

alternatives.interpretation: "Passes the 75-dollar cutoff" means amount > 75 (strictly greater than 75)
